subject: Penetration report & vulnerability process — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@helixhealth.com>; Peter Lewis <peter.lewis@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Penetration report & vulnerability process — follow-up and next steps

Hi Jane / Peter — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on security evidence and timelines.

Call recap (short):
- You asked for our latest third-party penetration test report, an outline of our vulnerability management cadence and SLA for triage/remediation, and confirmation on SOC 2 / HIPAA posture.
- We covered our scanning cadence (weekly unauthenticated scans; monthly credentialed scans; quarterly internal reviews; annual third-party pentest).

Action items I captured:
1) I will confirm what can be shared from the 2025 third-party pen test (we can provide a redacted copy that removes customer-identifying details and specific PoCs).
2) Share our SOC 2 Type II certificate and a short security summary — attached.
3) Send our vulnerability management SLA and expected timelines for critical / high / medium issues.
4) Initiate the vendor security questionnaire — link below.

Attachments sent with this message: Redwood_Security_Summary_2025.pdf; SOC2_TypeII_Certificate_2024.pdf; Vulnerability_Management_SLA.pdf

Proposed timelines:
- By EOD Mon (Mar 2): share redacted pen test report excerpt + SLA doc.
- By Wed (Mar 4): your security team completes the vendor questionnaire or flags follow-ups.

If you need the unredacted pen test under an NDA, we can coordinate a secure review but that typically requires a scoped NDA and limited reviewer list. If that will be required, please flag and I’ll loop our legal team.

Next step: I’ll upload the questionnaire to the HubSpot deal record and paste the link here.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

---

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@helixhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Lewis <peter.lewis@helixhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penetration report & vulnerability process — follow-up and next steps

Thanks Rafael — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) On the pen test report: we need enough technical detail to assess residual risk and whether any findings intersect with PHI storage/processing. A redacted version is usually fine, but we will likely request the full report under an NDA if there are findings that look material.

2) Can you confirm whether Redwood acts as a Business Associate under HIPAA for customers that handle PHI, and whether you have a BAA template?

3) For vulnerability SLAs, please call out measurable timelines for triage/mitigation and whether Redwood tracks fix time in a ticketing system we can audit.

4) We will expect a coordinated disclosure policy (minimum 30 days for remediation) before public disclosure — please confirm you’re comfortable with that for critical/high findings.

Also, please add our security questionnaire contacts to the vendor form — I will forward that to our SecOps team once the link is live.

Best,
Jane
Jane Doe
Security Operations Manager, Helix Health
jane.doe@helixhealth.com

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@helixhealth.com>; Peter Lewis <peter.lewis@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penetration report & vulnerability process — follow-up and next steps

Jane — thanks, notes below inline.

On pen test report: we can provide a redacted third-party report (removes customer identifiers and exact exploit PoCs). If Helix Health needs the unredacted report for legal/compliance review, we will require a scoped NDA and a named reviewer list — happy to start that process. Expected delivery: redacted excerpt attached by EOD today; full unredacted delivery time depends on legal clearance (typically 3–5 business days once NDA is in place).

HIPAA / BAA: Redwood does offer a BAA for customers handling PHI. I’ve looped Monica from Legal/Compliance for the template and next steps. Monica — can you confirm BAA availability and share the standard template?

Vulnerability SLAs (summary — full doc attached):
- Critical (e.g., remote code execution impacting production): initial triage within 4 business hours, mitigation plan within 3 business days, ETA for remediation tracked and updated every 24 hours until closed.
- High: initial triage within 1 business day, mitigation plan within 7 business days.
- Medium/Low: standard backlog process; measurable SLAs depend on impact and customer tier.
- We track all vulnerability tickets in Jira with audit logs and provide summary status in our security console for customers with dedicated deployments.

Coordinated disclosure: Redwood follows a coordinated disclosure process and is comfortable with a 30-day initial remediation window for critical/high findings. We ask that customers route vulnerability reports through our security@redwood.ai tracker to avoid public disclosure before coordination.

Questionnaire: link created and pushed to HubSpot (see link below). Please add your SecOps contacts.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Summary_2025.pdf; Vulnerability_Management_SLA.pdf; SOC2_TypeII_Certificate_2024.pdf

Link: https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-questionnaire/HLX-7932

Rafael

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@helixhealth.com>; Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:56:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penetration report & vulnerability process — follow-up and next steps

Hi Jane — confirmed: Redwood has a standard BAA template and we can execute with your procurement team. A couple of practical notes on sharing the pen test: 

- Redacted pen test: we can share the redacted PDF immediately (attaching the excerpt).
- Unredacted pen test: requires a signed scoped NDA and a named reviewer list; we typically host the unredacted file in a secure S3 bucket with expiring links for reviewers.
- If Helix requires on-site interviews or code review, that’s handled under a separate SOW.

Procurement/Legal next steps: Monica to connect with your procurement lead for BAA + minimal order form. I’ll also put a DocuSign envelope link in the HubSpot record for faster turnaround.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Peter Lewis <peter.lewis@helixhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penetration report & vulnerability process — follow-up and next steps

Thanks — two quick asks from my side as CISO: 
1) Please provide the most recent full pen test report (redacted if necessary) and the executive summary. If you require an NDA, send it to my attention and I’ll have our legal team review immediately.
2) Confirm the coordinated disclosure timeline in writing (we favor 30 days but will consider exceptions for active exploitation).

Once we receive the report and SLA doc, we’ll triage and get back with any follow-ups. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Peter Lewis
Chief Information Security Officer, Helix Health

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Peter Lewis <peter.lewis@helixhealth.com>; Jane Doe <jane.doe@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penetration report & vulnerability process — follow-up and next steps

Peter / Jane — closing the loop: 

- Redacted pen test excerpt and the Vulnerability Management SLA are attached to the HubSpot deal and I’ve also uploaded copies to a secure share. If you want the unredacted report, Monica will send the scoped NDA to the legal contact you provide.
- Coordinated disclosure: confirmed in writing — Redwood’s standard policy is 30 days for remediation from initial disclosure; exceptions for active exploit scenarios are handled case-by-case and we’ll coordinate immediately.
- Vendor questionnaire: the link is live here: https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-questionnaire/HLX-7932 — please add your SecOps reviewers and we’ll monitor completion.

Proposed mutual action plan: 
- Mar 2 (today): share redacted report + SLA (done).
- Mar 4: Helix completes questionnaire or flags open items.
- Mar 9: Joint review meeting (30 min) to discuss any critical/high findings and next steps.

Let me know if that timeline works and if you want Monica to route the NDA today.

Thanks,
Rafael
